Publish users to the website

Every change you make here is saved to users.json in your GitHub repo, so users can sign in from any browser or phone. It goes live about a minute after publishing. Time used and login counts are tracked per device.
How do I get a token? GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token. Pick only the LogicLab repository, set Contents: Read and write, generate and paste it above.
Manual option (no token) Export, then create a file called users.json in your repo and paste the text in. Import loads a list on this device.
